implementation_scope: Implement the 26 accepted tasks for contained prepared-source list/read/search, current-authority enforcement, Windows no-follow containment, truthful bounded outcomes, cancellation/resource settlement, thin Worker Agent functions and Git-bound regression preservation.
verification_route: Observable production behavior uses separate retained test and production owners with honest RED, minimal GREEN and final surrounding GREEN. Fixture setup and contract-only work use proportionate direct build/ownership checks without fabricated RED. Existing-correct Git behavior receives regression checks rather than manufactured failure.
coherent_groups: T001-T009: owned fixture, Core seam, approved-root issuance, containment and basic list/read MVP
T010-T018: bounded listing, strict ranges, literal search and closed Agent tool functions
T019-T025: live revocation/unavailability, truthful failures, cancellation, budgets and resource settlement
T026: final build, focused tests, retained-source regressions and scope inspection
principal_risk: The Windows handle-relative no-follow adapter and authority checks must remain race-resistant and fail closed; controlled tests cannot be replaced by lexical path checks or cached authorization.
approval_permits: First production/test writes for the accepted task boundary using governed TDD and direct verification routes.
approval_does_not_permit: New architecture, broader Scan strategy, PRD changes, Git/copy/hash/retention/database/provider/CodeGraph/LSP/UI/CLI scope, destructive runtime operations, or bypassing convergence, lookback, quality, E2E and final verification.
